phase: P3 causal autonomy: evidence-to-decision-to-action canary with rollback
question: Can EvoHive deterministically turn the three stopped P1 iterations and measured P2 overhead into a persisted next-operator decision, execute the emitted bounded experiment, and preserve an automatic rollback without a human choosing the operator after seeing the evidence?
hypothesis: The fixed policy reads only registered fields from the canonical P1 and P2 parent artifacts. With 0 verified 59s, minimum working violations [2,2,2], three stopped iterations and Modal startup overhead dominating, it selects asymmetric_random_greedy_screen, persists that decision before action, then executes exactly four empty-state asymmetric randomized-greedy trials on seeds 1400..1403 at 250 restarts. All trials must be dual-verified. The canary is expected to underperform 58 and therefore roll back while leaving solver/solver.c byte-identical; any different selection, configuration drift, oracle disagreement or incumbent mutation is an infrastructure failure.
primary_metric: causal transition gate: selected action and reason, decision timestamp before action start, emitted-versus-executed configuration equality, four dual-verified child artifacts, and incumbent hash before/after rollback. Search score is a canary diagnostic, not a record metric.
baseline: The incumbent is the frozen P0 solver/solver.c and its reproduced best score 58. Policy inputs are the three passed P1 parent artifacts (all 0 verified 59s and minimum two conflicts) plus the passed P2 parent artifact (startup overhead dominates). The selected canary starts from an empty grid and never reads an incumbent candidate or public certificate.
trial_definition: One trial is one seeded invocation of solver/asymmetric_greedy.c from an empty grid, performing 250 independent randomized greedy restarts in its own local subprocess.
cost_model: P3 is local-only and makes no provider calls, so its marginal cost is 0.0 USD. budget_usd remains the ceiling for the whole experiment. P2 provider cost remains unknown and is not reclassified.
stop_condition: Write the decision artifact before compilation or action. Run the selected canary exactly once. Stop and preserve evidence on any action/config mismatch, oracle disagreement or incumbent hash change. If the best score is below 58, record rolled_back and do not tune or rerun. If it reaches 58, mark only eligible_for_confirmation; do not replace the incumbent or spend seeds 64..127.
dual_verification_gate: A candidate is accepted only when the per-apex distance oracle (src/tripathy_experiment/no_isosceles.py) and the perpendicular-bisector oracle (src/tripathy_experiment/perpendicular_bisector_oracle.py) both accept it in the controller. Any disagreement is an infrastructure failure that is written to an artifact and makes the run exit nonzero. In P1 a 59 additionally counts only after a fresh process re-reads the persisted child artifact and both oracles plus the pinned upstream verify_construction accept it.

p0.question: Can a deterministic compiled local search that starts from an empty 32 x 32 grid reproduce the public 58-point no-isosceles result for AlphaEvolve Problem 59 under a fixed, declared iteration budget, with every result accepted only by two structurally independent exact oracles?
p0.hypothesis: At a fixed budget of 1000000 ruin/repair iterations per trial, at least one of the 64 from-scratch trials with seeds 0..63 of the mirror-symmetric baseline solver (solver/solver.c) reaches a dual-verified 58-point set, with zero oracle disagreements. The hypothesis is rejected if 0 of 64 trials reach 58.
p0.primary_metric: number of the 64 trials whose dual-verified cardinality reaches 58, reported with a 95% exact binomial interval; secondary metrics are best dual-verified cardinality, score distribution, wall and CPU seconds per trial, failure classes, and oracle disagreement count
p0.baseline: From-scratch deterministic C99 solver (solver/solver.c), symmetric under y -> 31-y, one seeded invocation per trial. The public 58-point certificate from google-deepmind/alphaevolve_repository_of_problems issue 10 is the external target only and is never used as solver initialization.
p0.trial_definition: One trial is one from-scratch seeded solver invocation in its own subprocess. Inner ruin/repair iterations are counted separately and are not trials.
p0.cost_model: P0 runs only on the local machine with no provider calls, so its marginal cost is 0.0 USD. The 20 USD figure is the ceiling for the whole experiment; none of it is authorized in P0.
p0.stop_condition: P0 stops after the single 64-trial gate. If the solver fails deterministic replay or the two oracles disagree, stop before the gate and preserve the failing fixture. If 0 of 64 trials reach 58, record a failed reproduction gate and stop without tuning on seeds 0..63. If at least one trial reaches 58, record a passed gate and stop; no 59-point record search is part of P0. If the gate would exceed 15 minutes of wall-clock time, lower the iteration budget and label the run a screening gate.

reproducibility.iteration_budget_calibration: Chosen on off-gate seeds 1000..1015 only: about 13 seconds per trial with 8 workers on an Apple M5 Max. Wall time is measured per trial as a secondary quantity.

p1_iteration_1.question: Starting from a dual-verified 58-point set that the frozen P0 solver produced from scratch, can conflict-guided single-point swaps at fixed cardinality 59 on arbitrary (non-mirror) point sets run with an exact incremental conflict invariant, emit only dual-verified candidates, and end in either a verified 59 or an auditable negative result with its closest approach?
p1_iteration_1.hypothesis: In the preregistered development smoke (breaker seeds 1000..1007, 200000 swaps per seed, 8 workers, sources round-robin across the distinct 58-point candidates of P0 run bb6b15b0-c0b9-426f-a67d-464cdce1a551), solver/symmetry_breaker.c compiles cleanly, replays byte-identically, all eight trials produce artifacts, both oracles agree on every emitted set, and there are zero false accepts, crashes, timeouts or malformed outputs, with every trial reporting a controller-recounted closest approach. The infrastructure hypothesis is rejected if any of these fails. Finding a 59 is a search success that is not required; not finding one is reported as a negative result.
p1_iteration_1.primary_metric: infrastructure gate status of the eight-trial smoke; search metrics are the count of 59-point sets accepted by both local oracles and the pinned upstream verifier from the persisted artifact in a fresh process, the best valid score, and the minimum number of isosceles triples reached at working cardinality 59 per trial (recounted by the controller); secondary metrics are failure classes, oracle disagreements, wall and CPU seconds, and cost
p1_iteration_1.trial_definition: One trial is one seeded symmetry-breaker invocation on one verified P0 candidate in its own subprocess. Inner swaps are counted separately and are not trials.
p1_iteration_1.stop_condition: Run the eight-seed smoke once. Stop before the smoke if the breaker's incremental state disagrees with brute force. Stop and preserve the artifact on any oracle disagreement. Do not tune on, or run, confirmatory seeds 64..127 in this tranche. Do not claim a record from the smoke: record_claim stays false even if a 59 is verified. No sponsor integration or Modal run is part of this tranche.

Search progress is then classified, without any tuning after seeing results, as record candidate (a persisted 59 accepted by both oracles and the pinned upstream verifier), operator progress (minimum working violations below 2, or exact repair reaches depth 5), or no progress (no 59 and minimum working violations stays 2). No record claim is made from development data in any case.

p2_result.speedup_claim: none: Modal was slower than both local parallel and local serial-equivalent at this budget
p2_result.isolation: all four Sandboxes: runtime vm requested and accepted, block_network true, 1 CPU, 512 MiB, 120 s lifetime, no secrets, no mounts; in-Sandbox probe reported network blocked and no credential-like env names; source read-back hash matched; each terminated in finally (exit 137); zero live Sandboxes in the app afterwards
p2_result.cost_status: unknown: the provider exposes no authoritative per-sandbox cost to this client
limits_of_the_evidence: One run of four seeds: no variance estimate, and no claim about scale beyond four Sandboxes.

The isolation probe runs inside the untrusted Sandbox and is self-reported: three outbound attempts (two TCP connects, one DNS lookup) failed. VM runtime rests on Modal accepting runtime='vm' and a non-gVisor kernel string; there is no provider-side attestation in the artifacts.

No-secrets rests on the gateway having no code path that attaches a Secret, Volume, mount or env, plus a names-only env screen. GPG_KEY (the public release-signing fingerprint name set by the upstream python base image) is allowlisted by exact name; its value was never read.
local_serial_equivalent_seconds is the sum of per-trial wall times under the parallel local run, not a separate serial run. In-Sandbox CPU time is not observable and is null.
sandbox_prepare_seconds (1.62 s) reflects an image cached by the disclosed preflight; the preflight's cold prepare took 11.13 s.
The Sandbox 'solve' phase (2.47 s mean) includes the exec round trip, so it is not a pure CPU comparison with the 1.04 s local trials.
